name: data-answer
description: A question answered from the person's own database: the definitions read, the question clarified, read-only SQL with the database's own checks after every query, every number traced to its query cell, and the figures recomputed independently by a model of another family and compared in code.

question.description: What to find out from the data.

db.description: The SQLite database file in the folder, e.g. data/shop.db

answer.title: Answer from the data
answer.prompt:
Answer this question from {{input.db}}, and write data/answer.md.

<question>
{{input.question}}
</question>

fix-provenance.title: Trace the numbers
fix-provenance.prompt:
Some numbers in data/answer.md do not come from a query cell. For each: cite the cell it came from and copy it exactly, mark it "(derived: ...)" with the cells it was computed from, or run the query that gives it. Run check_answer before you finish.

{{feedback}}

reconcile.title: Reconcile with the recomputation
reconcile.prompt:
An independent recomputation (data/recompute.md) does not agree with data/answer.md. Find out which is right from the database: re-run the queries, read the CHECKS lines, compare definitions and interpretations. Correct data/answer.md if it is wrong; if it is right, say in it why the recomputation differs. Run check_answer before you finish.

{{feedback}}

done-with-findings.title: Answer ready, not confirmed by the recomputation
